_comment: Copy this file, fill in one appointment session's inputs, and hand it to the agent runbook (see docs/40 Workflows/Appointment Sync Runbook.md). All six fields are required per step 1 of the workflow.

_field_notes.warehouse: 仓库供应商 — one of enums.warehouseOptions in config.js
_field_notes.destination: 目的地路线 — one of enums.destinationOptions (YEG/YYC/YVR 1-9)
_field_notes.isa: ISA appointment number provided this session
_field_notes.timestamp: 复制时间列 — the copy-time value tied to this ISA in table 5.6
_field_notes.actualPallets: 实际板数 — the actual pallet count provided this session
